CORRECTION_2026-08-02b.what_was_wrong: The prior commit's STATIC_FINDING traced the transform through 0x80048d48 (the -256 subtraction) and stopped, reporting -1600/-1952 as 'the' final values. That was INCOMPLETE, not wrong-headed -- there is one more gate at 0x80048d70 (lh v0,130($s1) == GROUNDED, per the independent player_update_80048138.c Canon binding) that was not traced. If GROUNDED != 0, the code skips straight to the store with s4 unchanged (giving -1600/-1952). If GROUNDED == 0 -- which IS the takeoff condition, since GROUNDED is cleared on the X-press that starts the jump, per the SAME already-existing Canon file -- it adds +256 and clamps against 4097 before storing.
CORRECTION_2026-08-02b.how_caught: Continuing the drill-down the user asked for: re-disassembled the full 0x80048d20-0x80048d8c range with a proper decoder (added slti/bgez/regimm handling that the first pass's decoder was missing) instead of stopping at the first plausible stopping point.
